findings.summary: Stored negative inclusion is a group sampling fraction, not exact stratified row propensity; training does not consume it.

limitations: Upstream incumbent, teachers and public checkpoints retain documented repeated-embryo/label exposure.
Source event labels are candidate-level local plausibility bags. Complete graph matching and one-to-one event assignment remain necessary after decoding.
Branch/permutation tests and randomized graph checks are bounded evidence, not an exhaustive proof of all event semantics.
The limited candidate pool, source bag overlap, and uncalibrated equal-class event scores remain statistical limitations.
reviewed: Prediction-only proposal and image crop construction before source labeling
Explicit source-only corpus filtering and opposite-source model application
Daughter permutation invariance in feature construction and model outputs
Actual per-daughter owner probability and distance, including future path owners
Complete donor continuation or termination edits
Adjacent incumbent fork handling in add-only and replacement arms
Transitive oversized component closure and exact no-op
scope: Independent bounded static, existing-test and synthetic-graph correctness audit; no frozen code, models, configs or candidate graphs changed
